subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-page Group by channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main partially covers channel grouping, but the requested merged timeline and separated tab mode require UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Scope The Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the current Group by channel plus per-session chat links is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace design to own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Scope The Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the closest current-main implementation and merged the recent channel grouping/category work.
